sections.heading: Detailed Design
paragraphs: Per the file, the migration from Loader (per the file) v2 program to Loader (per the file) v3 is only performed (per the file) by the runtime and (per the file) activated via a feature gate. The file describes the procedure to (per the file) follow to execute the migration. Per the file, each individual program upgrade (per the file) will reference the procedure (per the file) described in this SIMD (per the file) when proposing a migration (per the file) and specify its corresponding feature gate.

Per the file, migrating a Loader v2 (per the file) program to Loader v3 (per the file) involves creating a buffer acct owned by the Loader (per the file) v3 (BPF Upgradable Loader) (per the file) that contains the ELF (per the file) bytes of the program's (per the file) implementation to be migrated. Per the file, this buffer is deployed (per the file) before initiating the migration, (per the file) and a portion of (per the file) its lamports is later (per the file) used to fund the (per the file) new program and program data accts.

Per the file, any remaining lamports in (per the file) the buffer are burned (per the file) as part of the migration process. Per the file, the migration proceeds in (per the file) the following steps: **Create the program data acct**: A program data acct is derived from the program ID. Per the file, this acct must not already exist, (per the file) with one exception: if an acct with the derived address (per the file) exists, holds lamports, and (per the file) is owned by the (per the file) System Program, it may be reused.

Per the file, in that case, any (per the file) excess lamports are burned. Per the file, the ELF bytes from the buffer acct are then copied into this program data acct. **Rewrite the program acct**: The existing Loader v2 program acct is replaced with a Loader v3 program acct that references the newly created program data acct. Per the file, because Loader v2 programs (per the file) are not upgradable, they fail to have an upgrade authority, (per the file) and None is assigned (per the file) during migration. **Close the buffer acct**: Once both program and program data accts have been created and populated, the buffer acct is closed and any (per the file) remaining lamports are burned.

Per the file, in the slot immediately (per the file) following the feature activation, (per the file) the program will not be invocable. Per the file, this status will last (per the file) one slot, then the program is to be fully operational. Per the file, the program ID fails to change by this migration process. Per the file, each individual program migration ought to be controlled by its (per the file) own feature gate, which (per the file) triggers the migration process when activated.
